title: E-Commerce Analytics Dashboard
description: A comprehensive dashboard for monitoring sales performance, inventory levels, and customer insights in real-time.
challenge: The client needed to process thousands of transactions per minute without compromising UI performance. The main bottleneck was slow database queries on large datasets.
solution: I implemented database indexing strategies and used Redis for caching frequent queries. For the frontend, I used SWR for efficient data fetching and optimistic UI updates.

title: Smart Crop Disease Detection
description: An AI-powered mobile application that helps farmers detect plant diseases early by scanning leaves using their smartphone camera.
challenge: Developing a model that is lightweight enough to run on low-end mobile devices while maintaining high accuracy in varied lighting conditions.
solution: I utilized Transfer Learning with MobileNetV2 architecture to reduce model size. The model was then converted to TensorFlow Lite for offline inference on Android devices.
